recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No core source follow-up is needed for FHIR-5384 unless a future Vocab decision changes the semantics of active/inactive code handling in ValueSet expansion.
issue_request: FHIR-5384 was a Published FHIR-core ValueSet change request from the January 2015 ballot, resolved Persuasive with Modification, asking that the expansion process mention that when explicit codes are listed the server should check that the codes are valid and active.
initial_application: The Jira comments record svn revision 5882. In the git-svn history, commit 9ad0d3ed3dd056c40c39615e9739d202c1de2102 (2015-07-17, "#5384 - note about active codes in expansions") changed source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml from simply adding listed codes to requiring that listed codes be checked for validity and active status before they are added.
additional_context: ValueSet is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, so source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml is build-scoped source for the current specification. Later source history preserved the substance of the FHIR-5384 sentence while updating wording and links, including commit 4907f9bcb0b710cb2837a93a20c4b23210a37249. Related active/inactive expansion decisions FHIR-5787 and FHIR-18704 support the current treatment of inactive codes and the $expand controls, and no Zulip or Confluence search found a FHIR-5384-specific or conflicting community record.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. No source edit was made because source/valueset/valueset-notes.xml already says listed codes are checked for validity and active status before inclusion and references $expand parameters that control inactive-code inclusion.

related_jiras.note: Published DSTU1 ValueSet issue on active/inactive support in expansions; it explains why expansion parameters handle inactive-code inclusion, but it is a separate applied decision and was not decided here.

Published STU3 ValueSet issue noting the relationship between VSD.ActiveOnly and ValueSet.compose.inactive; its implementation preserved the FHIR-5384 active-status guidance while updating $expand links.
